Provides JavaScript interop for the adaptive CAPTCHA (Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise).

public interface ICaptchaService : IAsyncDisposable
Inherited Members
IAsyncDisposable.DisposeAsync()

Remarks

When the provider script cannot be loaded, the token-producing members return an empty string rather than failing. The server treats an empty token as invalid, so the outcome is fail-closed.
